snippet.title: Global MapleStory Classic World Grand Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Revisit the 2D side-scrolling MMORPG as it was at launch, enhanced with modern gameplay improvements, balance adjustments, and quality-of-life upgrades.

Gather your friends for party quests, familiar maps, and challenging adventures that capture the magic of discovering MapleStory for the first time.

Relive the adventure. Discover the nostalgia. Welcome back to Classic World.

Global MapleStory Classic World arrives October 21, 2026.

Learn More: https://www.nexon.com/maplestory/game/mscw/explore-maplestory

Check out our interview with Inkwell: https://www.nexon.com/maplestory/news/general/45681/inkwell-on-the-future-of-global-maple-story-and-classic-world

Watch Manji’s Burden: https://youtu.be/46XF58O6GIA?si=JGdD4QBF1SvK8YDt
Watch Dark Lord Awakens: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aUJpMVFtzEY
